summary: Consolidate the two number-checkers into one once both documents are on trunk: tools/check_design_numbers.py (OPPONENT_MODEL_DESIGN.md, on trunk) and tools/check_table_size_numbers.py (TABLE_SIZE_AND_SIZING_NOTES.md, added on branch worker/984aa6810a05 by fixer 4). They duplicate the half-up rounding helpers, the markdown table reader, the Checker equal/prose/every_occurrence surface and the exit-code contract. Kept separate deliberately: the table-size branch predates trunk's checker and must not merge trunk in. Do this after the table-size notes land, not before.
